sourceChecks.text: and they commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of the LORD your God’s covenant, and the Levitical priests bearing it, then leave your place and follow it.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: All Israel, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark before the Levitical priests, who carried the ark of the LORD’s covenant, the foreigner as well as the native; half of them in front of Mount Gerizim, and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded at the first, that they should bless the people of Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of the LORD, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of the LORD, these cities with their pasture lands.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as the LORD commanded by Moses.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBがレビ族/レビ人を集団として明示。初出3:3は契約の箱を担ぐ祭司の記述。

sourceChecks.text: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.
